name: Grand Hotel by the Sea
overview: An eight-episode series centered on the future of the prestigious 'Grand Hotel aan Zee' in Noordwijk, spanning 1912 to 1919. Hotel owner Sandra is determined to transform the Grand Hotel aan Zee within two years into the premier hotel for Europe’s elite along the Dutch coast. In her pursuit, she is confronted with the challenges of being an ambitious woman at the dawn of the 20th century.
